pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does MCA stand for? (1 mark)
   A. Master of County Affairs
   B. Mayor of Central Area
   C. Member of the County Assembly
   D. Minister of County Administration

2. Which of these is not a reason for crowded areas? (1 mark)
   A. Jobs in a town
   B. Fertile soil
   C. Very little rain and no water
   D. Good roads

3. During which season do fishermen often dry fish in the sun? (1 mark)
   A. Rainy season
   B. No season
   C. Flood season
   D. Dry season

4. Which of these is a correct body safety rule? (1 mark)
   A. No one should touch your private parts
   B. Keep it a secret if someone does
   C. Say nothing
   D. Anyone can touch them

5. Which of these can you call for help in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. The child helpline 116
   B. A cinema
   C. A bakery
   D. A shop

6. Which is a good way to develop a quality like punctuality? (1 mark)
   A. Wait for others to do it
   B. Ignore it
   C. Practise it every day
   D. Practise it once a year

7. Which activity can show leadership qualities in class? (1 mark)
   A. Copying
   B. Role-playing an elder settling a quarrel
   C. Sleeping
   D. Fighting

8. How can a historic place help a county to earn money? (1 mark)
   A. By closing to everybody
   B. By selling its walls
   C. By stopping all jobs
   D. By bringing visitors who pay fees and buy things

9. What does population distribution mean? (1 mark)
   A. How tall the mountains are
   B. How much rain falls
   C. How many trees are in an area
   D. How people are spread out in an area

10. What is the raw material for sugar? (1 mark)
   A. Tea leaves
   B. Sugarcane
   C. Milk
   D. Wheat

11. Which action shows cooperation? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Sharing tasks in a group
   C. Copying others
   D. Doing nothing

12. Who usually guides a Children's Government? (1 mark)
   A. A driver
   B. A stranger
   C. A police officer
   D. A teacher patron

13. Which quality means treating everyone equally? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Fairness
   C. Boasting
   D. Selfishness

14. Which of these is a traditional drink of the Kalenjin? (1 mark)
   A. Coffee
   B. Mursik
   C. Wine
   D. Cola

15. Which practice do Kenyan laws forbid because it harms girls? (1 mark)
   A. Playing bao
   B. Wearing beads
   C. Female genital mutilation
   D. Cooking ugali

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State three duties of clan elders. (3 marks)

17. What is meant by a densely populated area? (2 marks)

18. Describe what people do in the cold season to stay healthy and warm. (4 marks)

19. Explain how the Tana River helps people in Kenya. (3 marks)

20. Name the three main kinds of historic built environments. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Member of the County Assembly
   MCA is a Member of the County Assembly.

2. C — Very little rain and no water
   Dryness with no water makes areas sparse.

3. D — Dry season
   Dry sunny days are best for drying fish.

4. A — No one should touch your private parts
   Your body belongs to you.

5. A — The child helpline 116
   Childline Kenya can be reached on 116.

6. C — Practise it every day
   Habits grow with practice.

7. B — Role-playing an elder settling a quarrel
   Role play shows how leaders act.

8. D — By bringing visitors who pay fees and buy things
   Visitors spend money on tickets, guides and crafts.

9. D — How people are spread out in an area
   Distribution is about where people live.

10. B — Sugarcane
   Sugar is made from sugarcane.

11. B — Sharing tasks in a group
   Cooperation is working well with others.

12. D — A teacher patron
   A teacher adviser guides the pupils.

13. B — Fairness
   Fair leaders treat all equally.

14. B — Mursik
   Mursik is fermented milk.

15. C — Female genital mutilation
   FGM is against the law.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Keep customs, settle disputes and advise at ceremonies.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each duty.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: An area where many people live close together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for many people, 1 mark for close together.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: They wear warm clothes, eat and drink hot foods, sleep under blankets, and wash their hands to avoid colds and flu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: It supplies water, its dams produce electric power, and its water is used for irrigation.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct use.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Museums, monuments and cultural centres.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct kind.
